notes.text: Direct homogeneous uniaxial evaluation of PhysGaussian's jelly fixed-corotated law as implemented in mpm_solver_warp/mpm_utils.py: tau = 2 mu (F-R) F^T + lambda J(J-1)I. mu=2*C10=1417326 Pa and nu=0.45; the transverse stretch is solved independently at every axial stretch so transverse PK1/Cauchy stress is zero. Direct constitutive evaluation is equivalent to the homogeneous quasi-static MPM limit and avoids pull-rate and fixture artifacts.
